paragraphs: Prominent Contact is a beautiful Reactstrap (Bootstrap 4) admin dashboard with a large number of components, designed to look neat and organized. If you are looking for a tool to manage and visualize data about your business, this dashboard is the thing for you. It combines colors that are easy on the eye, spacious cards, beautiful typography, and graphics. Prominent Contact comes packed with all plugins that you might need inside a project and documentation on how to get started. It is light and easy to use, and also very powerful.

We made it our priority to not add things that you don't need, so the Prominent Contact comes with just enough features for you to easily use. It combines multiple components and plugins and features numerous example of how it can be used. Inside the archive, you will also find multiple example pages to get you started or provide inspiration.

Prominent Contact is the extended version of Prominent Contact. Based on feedback from people that downloaded and used it, we have added needed components, and we have created multiple examples pages. We are curious to see how you want to use it and also improve it, so let us know any feedback you have.
